deltas.description: 2 change-signals on Client-Server REST API (edge zone): new entry point, asset-handling change. STRIDE: InformationDisclosure: returns any user's account data and messages without authorization; ElevationOfPrivilege: non-admin caller reads arbitrary users' data by id; Spoofing: user_id read from query string, not bound to an authenticated caller
